Registry/job fields strongly retain the original future while any waiter is cancelled. Shared coordinates polls and retains one terminal result.

Circuit Shared output is unit; the original non-Clone AgentdError or result remains in one separate Arc<short std Mutex> cell with no back-reference. No await separates real JoinHandle completion from retaining exact result and outcome.

Session and consumer retain their existing Option handle/observed state and exact missing-handle refusal. A short lock clones the actual future, awaiting happens outside it, and a short lock records its exact cached terminal.
